long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The clay bank is wet and orange, and I want the first piece of the day.
My paws are empty, so I will take one piece of clay before anyone else can.
The workbench is where clay becomes something worth keeping, and I am carrying it there.
One piece of clay should become a small figure I can keep where I can see it.
Seeds that grow without permission are a mystery I have not yet settled, so I will read about them.
A high place lets me see who is coming up the beach, and I like to be above things.
Energy is low after all that claiming, and a patch of sun is the right place to spend it.

today.reason: I will cut and shape one piece of clay into something worth keeping, learn about unknown seeds, and then spend the rest of the day up high and in the sun.
